properties.description: TRL/MRL readiness as its own construct — a `ReadinessAssessment` carrying an integer level 1-9 and a kind, attached to the enabling technology — plus a `GATED_ON` edge from the increment to that technology carrying the level it demands, and a `TemporalFact` forecast series marking itself `forecast` rather than `measured` with author-stated confidence. From those three the delivery epoch is computed FORWARD: the earliest epoch by which every gating technology clears its stated level, reported with the reason ("2036 because this component is TRL 3 today, projected 7 in 2035, and this increment needs 7"). Refuses to invent a threshold: an ungated increment is reported ungated, never ready.
properties.name: Readiness gates an increment, and the roadmap says why
